findings: Binance's October 31 Update #3 claims 90% total replenishment and 100% backing for ten named assets including XRP; the full ZK proof is estimated by November 3.
Binance says the remaining 10% consists of less-liquid assets outside the top ten; no XRP-specific replenishment purchase is disclosed.
Lookonchain reports a 7,500 BTC transfer from the SAFU fund to a new wallet; Arkham shows 7.5K BTC remaining at the labeled source address. Destination and transaction hash are unknown.
XRP Insights' October 31 08:00 UTC snapshot shows 22.48B XRP across 701 wallets/24 exchanges, Binance 2.78B, Coinbase 5.85B and Upbit 6.43B.
XRP Insights shows a +105.9M same-wallet daily rebound on October 31 after -207.3M October 30; Binance-attributed wallets are +17.6M over seven days and +30.3M over 30 days.
The earlier persistent 220M Binance XRP reserve-depletion interpretation is weakened; broad exchange balances include 487.2M in wrapped/operational reserve balances and are not tradable float.
next_actions: Trace the 7,500 BTC transfer to its destination and inspect subsequent activity.
Verify Binance's November 3 full PoR proof and same-time XRP liabilities.
Crosswalk Binance XRP wallet sets across providers and exclude wrapped reserves from tradable-float calculations.
